label: WATCH
rationale: Axon is a high-quality, founder-led public-safety technology platform with strengthening ecosystem economics, 39% ARR growth, 126% NRR and $15.1 billion future contracted bookings. However, current valuation still embeds high-teens-to-20% long-duration growth, first-half 2026 free cash flow is negative, stock-based compensation is extremely high, and share count continues to rise. The combination of valuation and dilution prevents a starter position under the harness despite strong business quality.
increase_evidence: Price falls enough to create at least ~20% discount to a re-underwritten base value without business deterioration.
ARR remains above ~25% growth and NRR remains at or above ~120% while international/enterprise bookings convert to revenue.
GAAP operating margin and owner-FCF margin expand materially while annual net dilution trends toward <=1%-2%.
Carbyne, Dedrone and other acquisitions demonstrate measurable cross-sell, margin contribution and acceptable acquisition ROIC.
reduce_or_exit_evidence: ARR growth falls below ~20% with NRR below ~115% for multiple quarters absent a temporary deployment timing issue.
Future contracted bookings growth materially decelerates and cancellations/appropriation issues rise.
SBC and net dilution remain structurally high without commensurate per-share FCF growth.
Major ecosystem categories lose share or Evidence.com switching costs weaken.
Acquisition spending continues to raise leverage while owner cash flow fails to inflect.
